thread:
Aisha: Hey team — I'm the new on-call shadow this week. Wanted to confirm handoff plan for tonight and check any hot tickets I should watch for. Also can someone share the concise runbook pointers?

Ben: Welcome aboard! I'm primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC shift tonight. Miguel is secondary. Key things:
- Pager policy: P0/P1 pages go to primary immediately, mention @secondary if still unack'd after 5m.
- Escalation: if primary is unreachable for 10m, page escalation group (see runbook link).
- Runbook excerpts: check prefix cache miss rate, GPU OOMs, and router error 503 spikes.

Ben: Quick links: internal runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference (read the 'live mitigation' section), paging playbook -> https://redwood.internal/pager/policy. For shadowing: pair with me on first page and be ready to follow the mitigate checklist.

incident-bot: Incident summary: last page (P1) at 1965431200 for high tail latency; mitigated via routing fallback at 1965431500. Relevant incident thread: #incident-2026-03-inference-latency.

Miguel: Two heads-up items: 1) We have a scheduled model batch rollout at 23:30 UTC via deploy-bot (can cause short 503 spikes if mem config off). 2) APAC coverage gap 02:00-06:00 UTC — rotating on-call volunteers needed if we expect traffic.

Aisha: Got it. For the model rollout, is there an automated canary? What's the abort condition?

Ben: Yes, deploy-bot does a gradual canary: 1%->10%->50%. Abort conditions are >5% 503s over baseline for 10m or 10% latency regression on p95 vs baseline. Abort command is: `/deploy abort <deploy-id>` (we also have a quick revert: `/deploy rollback <model>-<ver>`).

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: model: redwood-opt-13b-q4, deploy-id: dpl-20260314-7, start: 23:30 UTC, canary windows: 5m each.

Ben: Known issues right now: intermittent KV-cache cold starts after restarts (seen in logs as "kv_cache_miss spike"). Mitigation: trigger cache warmup job: `kubectl exec -c warmup svc/cache-warmup -- /app/warmup --range 0-1000` and watch prefix_miss_rate in Grafana dashboard 'inference/kv'.

Miguel: Customer impact note: No active P0s. A handful of requests from enterprise-corp A had higher latency last night but within SLA. If a customer-facing alert triggers, forward to customer-success with the incident summary template (link pinned in runbook).

Clara: I can cover the 01:30-03:00 UTC overlap if we need extra pair to handle the rollout. I'm happy to shadow the primary for the first canary window.

Aisha: Thanks Clara. Ben, can we do a 20m pre-rollout check-in at 23:10 UTC so I can shadow decision-making on abort/continue?

Ben: Yep. Let's meet @23:10 in #eng-oncall huddle thread. Pre-rollout checklist: 1) confirm CPU/GPU utilization <70% cluster-wide 2) confirm no recent P1s in last 1h 3) ensure autoscaler active 4) confirm rollback command available and tested.

Aisha: Noted. Any quick commands I should memorize tonight?

Ben: Essentials:
- Check queues: `redis-cli -h redis-infer LRANGE queue:hot 0 50`
- Check pods: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide`
- Tail logs for a suspected instance: `stern inference --since 10m`
- Check metrics: open Grafana -> inference/latency and set time range 30m.

Aisha: Perfect. One more: if I get paged and I'm unsure, do I ping you first or escalate?

Ben: Ping me first (@Ben). If you can't reach me in 5 minutes, follow the escalation ladder in the runbook (secondary->team lead->eng-sre). For the shadowing week, your first action should be 'ack and triage', then run the quick diagnostics above.

Miguel: Also add: annotate the page with the initial triage steps you ran (helps postmortem). Use this template: `Initial triage: ack, checked queues, checked pod health, looked at grafana p95/p99, any customer impact?`

Aisha: Will do. Thanks all — I'll be online 22:45 UTC for handoff and will join the 23:10 pre-rollout check. Looking forward to shadowing the canary.

Clara: Welcome again — ping if anything weird comes up. :thumbsup:

Ben: Thanks Aisha. I'll DM you the small checklist file and the safe-rollback model tag before 23:00.

Aisha: Received. Signing off for now, will be back at 22:45 UTC.
